accept.reason: false positive from this branch's own settings-file rename (migration 2026-08-23-settings-file-rename): the check's base/head pairing (packs/claudinite-lifecycle/skills/adopt-pack/checks.mjs, via engine/checks/helpers/work.mjs jsonPair/readBase) reads both sides at the SAME literal filename, so on the exact branch that renames the settings file, readBase(the new name) finds nothing at the merge-base and every already-declared pack misreads as newly added. Every already-pending adoption question (pre-existing on main, unrelated to this update) then trips as a blocking new-pack omission. Explained in full on GoogleCalendarEventCreator#1029. Prune this once the check gains rename-awareness (or the real pending questions get answered, which would also need this removed first so the answers actually get reviewed).
